# jamfpro_v1_distribution_point (Data Source)

Get specified distribution point.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

data "jamfpro_v1_distribution_point" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `https_username` (String) Required if httpsSecurityType is USERNAME_PASSWORD
- `name` (String)
- `read_only_username` (String) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `read_write_username` (String) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `server_name` (String)
- `share_name` (String) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `ssh_username` (String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `backup_distribution_point_id` (String)
- `enable_load_balancing` (Boolean) This is used to configure load balancing on the backup distribution point. Cannot be enabled when the backup distribution point configured is cloud.
- `file_sharing_connection_type` (String) Specify the type of connection , Either of fileSharingConnectionType (or) https connection type needs to be enabled using httpsEnabled for a distribution point to be created.
- `https_context` (String) Path to the share (e.g. if the share is accessible at http://192.168.10.10/JamfShare, the context is "JamfShare") - required if HTTPS enabled
- `https_enabled` (Boolean) Allow downloads over HTTPS - requires installation of a valid SSL certificate
- `https_password` (String) Required if httpsSecurityType is USERNAME_PASSWORD
- `https_port` (Number) Port number of the server - required if HTTPS enabled
- `https_security_type` (String) Type of authentication required to download files from the distribution point - required if HTTPS enabled
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `local_path_to_share` (String)
- `port` (Number) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `principal` (Boolean)
- `read_only_password` (String) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `read_write_password` (String) Required if fileSharingConnectionType is either AFP (or) SMB
- `ssh_password` (String)
- `workgroup` (String)
